name: Refugio Frey
region: Nahuel Huapi National Park, Cerro Catedral
why: Bariloche's great hike: a stone hut by a lake ringed by granite towers. Sleep there to see them at sunrise.
book: Free trail. To sleep at the hut, book with the Club Andino Bariloche.
water: Streams along the Van Titter valley; food and drinks at the hut.
dangers: The last hour is steep and rocky.
Snow lies around the lake until December.
turnaround: Reach the hut by 14:00 to come down in daylight.

points.name: Villa Catedral

points.name: Arroyo Van Titter valley
points.note: The Van Titter stream in lenga forest, near the small Petricek shelter: the long middle of the day.

points.name: Refugio Frey
points.note: About 1,700 m: the stone hut, Laguna Toncek and the granite needles of Cerro Catedral.
